# {fmt} (vendored)

{fmt} 12.1.0 (https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt), taken unchanged from the copy bundled in the ReXGlue SDK 0.10.0
(`thirdparty/fmt`). Only `include/fmt/base.h`, `core.h`, `format.h` and `format-inl.h` are kept; it is used
header-only (`FMT_HEADER_ONLY`) by the Xenos shader translator (`../xenos_shader`).

License: MIT, see `LICENSE` (copied unchanged).
